presidential_rule_won: The election was decided in this round.
presidential_rule_runoff: Nobody was elected in this round — a runoff follows.
presidential_rule_majority_met: ✓ The leading pair has more than half of the valid votes.
presidential_rule_majority_unmet: ✗ No pair has more than half of the valid votes.
presidential_rule_turnout_met: ✓ More than half of the registered voters took part.
presidential_rule_turnout_unmet: ✗ Fewer than half of the registered voters took part.
presidential_share_denominator: Shares are of the valid votes — the ticket votes plus “none of the above”, where the form asked for it.
presidential_invalid_note: Invalid ballots are paper-only in every election — a machine does not accept one.
presidential_turnout_basis_all: Signatures in the rolls over registered voters, across every section including those abroad.
presidential_turnout_basis_domestic: Signatures in the rolls over registered voters, for domestic sections only — this election's protocols from abroad carry neither a roll nor a signature count.
presidential_abroad_no_turnout: There is no register of voters outside the country to measure turnout against, so this is a count of ballots rather than a percentage.
presidential_swing_note: Only the tickets that stood in both rounds. A ticket absent from the runoff did not fall to zero — it was not standing.
presidential_not_published: Results for this presidential election have not been published yet.
presidential_unusable: The published data for this election could not be read.
presidential_place_not_published: No result has been published for this place in this presidential election.
presidential_regions_share_note: This share is of the votes cast for a pair in that oblast — “none of the above” is not in it, which is why it is higher than the share in the national ranking.
presidential_namesake_hint: {{count}} public figures carry this name — no profile is linked, because we cannot say which of them the candidate is.
presidential_transfer_heading: Where the runoff's votes came from
presidential_transfer_title: Vote transfer between the two rounds
presidential_transfer_hint: A section-level estimate: how the first round's split is consistent with the runoff result. No voters were tracked.
presidential_transfer_precision: Estimate precision: the ribbons and the column labels differ by at most {{pct}}. Scaling equalises the totals but does not fully converge where an oblast's pattern is nearly degenerate.
presidential_transfer_coverage: Covers {{sections}} sections inside the country. {{abroad}} votes cast abroad are outside the estimate.
presidential_pickup_heading: How much of the eliminated vote {{president}}'s gain is equal to
presidential_pickup_note: No estimate here — arithmetic on published protocols only. The winner's gain is compared with the votes for the pairs that did not reach the runoff. It does NOT mean those voters chose them.
presidential_pickup_map_label: {{place}}: {{president}}'s gain equals {{pct}} of the votes for the eliminated pairs
presidential_transfer_coverage_unplaced: A further {{sections}} sections ({{votes}} votes) could not be placed in an oblast and are outside it too.
presidential_split_hint: Votes for the pair and for the same nominator's list, in the same section, on the same day. The figure is a lower bound, not a measurement.
presidential_split_refused_finalists: The two who reached the runoff are among them: {{names}}. The parties that backed them are not recorded on the ballot and are not attributed here.
presidential_split_refused_committee_one: A further pair was nominated by an initiative committee and has no list to compare against: {{names}}.
presidential_split_refused_committee_oth: A further {{count}} pairs were nominated by initiative committees and have no list to compare against: {{names}}.
presidential_split_refused_unmatched_one: For a further pair the nominator could not be resolved to exactly one list in the parliamentary catalogue, so it is not compared: {{names}}.
presidential_split_refused_unmatched_oth: For a further {{count}} pairs the nominator could not be resolved to exactly one list in the parliamentary catalogue, so they are not compared: {{names}}.
presidential_split_coverage_abroad: {{sections}} sections compared; {{abroad}} sections outside the country stay out of the comparison, so the figures sit below the national results.
presidential_flash_hint: What the voting machine itself recorded, against what the section commission wrote in the protocol. The two documents are produced independently, so the difference is a cross-check rather than arithmetic.
presidential_flash_coverage_note: {{pct}} of machine votes compared, across {{sections}} sections; {{left}} machine votes sit outside the comparison, in sections with no flash record. The difference is between two independently produced documents and is not in itself an irregularity.
presidential_transfer_table_caption: Where the first-round votes went, as estimated — one row per first-round line, one column per runoff option.
presidential_transfer_table_note: Each row shows where that first-round line's votes went, as estimated; the columns are the runoff options and the percentages are shares of the row's own votes. A dash means a flow below the estimate's threshold, not a zero flow, which is why the rows do not add up to exactly 100%. A „< {{pct}}“ cell is a real but very small flow.
presidential_transfer_table_none_a11y: a flow below the estimate's threshold, not a zero flow
